data.body:
VERIFIER FLIP-RATE MINING (archival, read-only; full report: session-state cd66bacc files/verifier-flip-rates.md; extends verifier-failure-mining.md).

SOURCE: 1,459 durable COMPLETION_VERDICT events (2026-07-12→08-15; PASS=1015 full per-criterion vectors, FAIL=351 unmet-only findings, ERROR=40 zero-banked, +53 epic-bug screens excluded). 997 tickets have >=1 attempt, 281 have >=2. Exhaustive sweep of all 4,298 ticket dirs — no sampling. 'No intervening change' = identical verified_at_sha AND zero ticket events (edit/tag/comment) between adjacent attempts.

NOISE FLOOR (identical code+ticket state): per-criterion flip rate 5.8% high-confidence (8/137 recorded-to-recorded comparisons), 6.5% incl. FAIL-findings inference (18/278). RUN-LEVEL: 7/39 adjacent same-sha no-event pairs flipped verdict = 18% (6 FAIL→PASS, 1 PASS→FAIL). For contrast: changed-state pairs flip 44% per-criterion (legit remediation), comment-only pairs 76% run-level (the remediation loop working).

TOP-5 WORST: (1) 9843 rancid-aerophobic-skylark — PASS,PASS,FAIL at one sha within ~8min; run 3 rejected the same operator-attested comment runs 1-2 accepted. (2) 2db2 adjoining-slushy-thylacine — FAILx6 then PASS, ALL 7 runs at sha 694cf894. (3) 8185 radical-yellowish-okapi — 2 operator-attested criteria unmet→met, same sha, nothing between. (4) f789 uncheered-sombre-bumblebee — 2 codebase-verifiable criteria flipped attempts 2→3, same sha. (5) cb91 wailsome-unsure-asianlion — 4 criteria oscillated between adjacent FAILs at same sha (inferred basis).

FORCE-CLOSE CENSUS: 183 FORCE_CLOSE audit records (was 146 at dd41's 08-12 count). 151 (83%) have ZERO verdict events; 18 have 1; 14 have >=2 — of those 14, only 1 (5e53, 7%) shows a no-change flip (2 counting comment-only = 14%). Flip-noise explains at most ~1-2 of 183 force-closes; the driver remains availability (ERROR/zero-bank wedges + administrative closes), confirming dd41.

EVIDENCE-CLASS SPLIT — hypothesis NOT supported: flips do NOT concentrate in prose/runtime ACs. No-change flip rates: greppable-artifact 11.3% (6/53), runtime-outcome 8.9% (4/45), prose 4.4% (8/180). The 8 high-confidence flips by verifier's own kind: 5 codebase-verifiable (absence-as-refutation: bounded search finds the artifact one run, misses it the next) vs 3 operator-attested (evidence-kind reclassification of the same comment). Caveat: n=18, regex class heuristic.

LIMITATIONS: (a) FAIL events bank only UNMET criteria — met-on-FAIL must be inferred from findings absence, unsafe on budget-truncated runs (10/18 flips are inference-based; upper bound). (b) ERROR runs bank nothing — zero-banking wedges invisible to flip analysis. (c) verified_at_sha missing on 434/1406 events (bucketed 'change', deflating counts). (d) Pre-2026-07-12 attempts exist only as prose in comments — unrecoverable per-criterion; hence 151/183 force-closes have no event-level gate history. (e) A comment between runs conservatively voids no-change even when unrelated. Net: 5.8-6.5%/criterion and 18%/run are FLOORS. Implication: same-state re-verification is nondeterministic; per-criterion verdict caching keyed on tree-hash (fix C's bank) adds signal, re-rolling adds noise.
